title: Roof Replacement in Troutdale, OR
summary: In October 2024, French Roofing replaced the old wood shake roof on a home in Troutdale, OR. The crew tore off all the old roofing, put new underlayment and shake liner over the skip sheathing, and installed new resawn shakes with new flashings, new attic vents and standard ridge caps.
scope: Tore off all layers of the old shake roof
Installed new underlayment and shake liner over the skip sheathing
New painted drip edge and gable flashing, plus a shake starter course
Installed new resawn shakes with standard ridge caps
New front wall and sidewall flashing, new power pole flashing and new double-seal vent pipe flashings
Replaced the attic vents with new metal vents
Cleaned out the gutters, hauled away the debris and ran a magnet over the yard
body: The old shakes had gone gray and mossy by the time we got up there. Everything came off, and the photos below follow the job from the old roof, through the new underlayment, to the finished shakes.

faqs.question: Did the old shakes come off on this Troutdale job?
faqs.answer: Yes. All layers of the old roof came off before the new underlayment, shake liner and shakes went on.

faqs.question: What went back on the roof?
faqs.answer: New resawn wood shakes with standard ridge caps, new flashings and new metal attic vents.
